'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023–present)|Middle Eastern crisis]]
**[[2026 Iran war]]
***[[2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis]]
****[[Naval blockade of Iran]]
*****[[United States]] [[President of the United States|president]] [[Donald Trump]] says that the [[United States Navy|U.S. naval]] [[blockade]] will remain in effect until a [[2025–2026 Iran–United States negotiations|peace agreement]] is reached with Iran. [https://aje.news/zo0udq?update=4500249 (Al Jazeera)]
*****[[Fars News Agency]] reports that the [[Government of Iran|Iranian government]] considers the continuation of the blockade a violation of the [[2026 Iran war ceasefire|ceasefire]] and would close the strait again if it is not lifted. [https://www.iranintl.com/en/202604170620 (''Iran International'')]
****[[Minister of Foreign Affairs (Iran)|Iranian foreign minister]] [[Abbas Araghchi]] announces that the [[Strait of Hormuz]] will be open for commercial traffic via a "coordinated route" with Iranian authorities while the 10-day [[2026 Israel–Lebanon ceasefire|ceasefire]] in [[Lebanon]] is in effect. [https://www.cnbc.com/2026/04/17/iran-war-hormuz-strait-israel-lebanon-ceasefire.html (CNBC)]
****[[Celestyal Discovery]] becomes the first [[cruise ship]] to successfully transit the [[Strait of Hormuz]] since the start of the war on February 28 after being previously docked in [[Dubai]] for 47 days. [https://cruiseindustrynews.com/cruise-news/2026/04/celestyal-ship-crosses-strait-of-hormuz/ (Cruise Industry News)] [https://www.euronews.com/2026/04/17/first-cruise-ship-transits-the-strait-of-hormuz-since-iran-war-began (Euronews)]
****An [[Islamic Republic of Iran Armed Forces|Iranian military]] official says that vessels must receive permission from the [[Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps]] to pass. [https://aje.news/zo0udq?update=4500278 (Al Jazeera)]
****Maritime tracking data shows that only a few ships have moved through the strait after the announcement. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cwydexp39ddo (BBC)]
***[[2025–2026 Iran–United States negotiations]]
****[[Iran]] denies that it agreed to give up its [[highly enriched uranium]]. [https://aje.news/zo0udq?update=4500849 (Al Jazeera)] [https://aje.news/zo0udq?update=4500892 (Al Jazeera)]
**[[Hezbollah–Israel conflict]]
***[[2026 Lebanon war]]
****[[Israel]]i [[Ministry of Defense (Israel)|defense minister]] [[Israel Katz]] says that [[Israel Defense Forces|the military]] will hold all of its positions in [[southern Lebanon]], and that disarming [[Hezbollah]] remains its main objective. [https://aje.news/zo0udq?update=4499909 (Al Jazeera)]
****The Israeli military issues a statement telling residents from southern Lebanon to remain north of the [[Litani River]] during the ceasefire. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/4/17/what-we-know-about-the-israel-lebanon-ceasefire (Al Jazeera)]
****The [[Lebanese Armed Forces|Lebanese military]] says that there have been several Israeli attacks and [[artillery]] [[Shell (projectile)|shelling]] incidents in violation of the ceasefire. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/4/17/what-we-know-about-the-israel-lebanon-ceasefire (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Moro conflict]]
**Ten [[Maute Group]] militants, including a leader, are killed in a [[shootout]] with [[Philippine Army|soldiers]] during a raid in [[Marantao]], [[Lanao del Sur]], [[Philippines]]. [https://punchng.com/philippines-forces-kill-10-militants-in-arrest-gunfight/ (AFP via ''The Punch'')]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Economic impact of the 2026 Iran war]]
**[[2026 Iran war fuel crisis]]
***[[China–Turkmenistan relations]], [[Energy in Turkmenistan]]
****[[China]] and [[Turkmenistan]] begin expansion works at the [[Galkynyş Gas Field]], the world's second-largest [[gas field]], to increase production amid the fuel crisis. [https://www.sinodaily.com/afp/260417094918.orlt05jd.html (AFP via SpaceWar.com)]
***[[Russia–United States relations]]
****The [[United States]] issues a one-month [[United States government sanctions|sanctions]] waiver allowing the sale of [[Russia]]n [[Petroleum industry in Russia|petroleum products]] already in transit to help stabilize global energy supply. [https://www.abs-cbn.com/news/business/2026/4/18/us-extends-sanctions-waiver-on-purchases-of-russian-oil-1118 (AFP via ABS-CBN News)]
***A [[South Korea]]n [[Tanker (ship)|tanker]] transports [[crude oil]] to the country via the [[Red Sea]] for the first time since [[2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis|disruptions]] to the [[Strait of Hormuz]], as [[Cabinet of Lee Jae Myung|the government]] implements alternative supply routes to secure [[Energy in South Korea|energy imports]]. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/east-asia/first-south-korean-tanker-transits-alternative-red-sea-route-6063256 (AFP via CNA)]
**[[Price of oil|Oil prices]], including [[Brent Crude]] and [[West Texas Intermediate]], drop to less than [[United States dollar|US$]]90 per [[Barrel (unit)|barrel]], and the [[Dow Jones Industrial Average]] increases by over 1,000 points, following Iran's announcement of the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz. [https://apnews.com/article/stock-markets-trump-oil-iran-war-50e10bf2aa9b0b658c51e17db3eb3b13 (AP)]
